note: Emmet County Conservation park on 467-acre High Lake, 6 mi east of Wallingford, beside the Emmet County Nature Center and arboretum. The loops sit in woods behind a treeline along the shore; swimming at Pappy's Lakeside beach nearby. --Claude
summary: Changed booking reservable online -> first come, first served only (county: 'No Reservations'); sites 90 -> 83; fees $25 confirmed (seniors $23, weekly rates, $15 tent-only 30-amp); 30/50-amp; hydrants, showers, flush toilets, dump confirmed; season mid-April to mid-October with the 2026 utilities shut-off noted. Pin is ~45 m from the loop centre (fine). Waterfront lead lakeview -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN (lead, lakeview -> not waterfront, by the unsure-downgrade rule): on Esri imagery (43.31082,-94.70486, 120 m) the loops sit under canopy north of the campground's own south loop road; between that road and the High Lake shore is a continuous ~20 m tree strip, so no pad is on the water and the loop road blocks on-water anyway. No official photo shows the lake from a site (the county's 2026 campground photo shows only woods and lawn). The operator's 'overlooking High Lake' is marketing. A filtered view from sites along the south road is possible but unconfirmed, so it goes down. The stored waterfront_evidence also names the wrong lake ('Iowa Lake'; this is High Lake).
